item.title: AA Edit | Gold Soars On Dollar Doubts
item.description: The yellow metal soared 64 per cent in 2025, its biggest annual gain since 1979, driven by safe-haven demand, US monetary policy easing, robust central bank purchases, including China’s 14th straight month of gold buying in December, and record inflows into exchange-traded funds
